transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello doctor. For the past three weeks, I've been feeling extremely stressed and constantly on edge, and I just can't seem to think clearly. My mind feels completely foggy and I'm having a really hard time focusing on even the simplest things.
Did these symptoms start after a specific stressful or traumatic event happened to you? If so, what was it?

I've just been experiencing a massive amount of stress and constant tension lately. I'm not really sure if there was one specific event that triggered it, but everything has just felt incredibly overwhelming. I've just been so on edge.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling down or depressed, or have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

No, I wouldn't say I've been feeling depressed or that I've lost interest in the things I usually enjoy. It's not really a feeling of sadness, but rather just being constantly tense and unable to think clearly.
Have you been feeling worried or on edge like this most days for at least the past six months, or did it begin only recently?
No, it hasn't been going on for six months. This started very recently, specifically about three weeks ago, and I've been feeling this way ever since.
Since this started, have you had a terrifying or life-threatening event and then experienced things like unwanted memories, nightmares, feeling detached, or avoiding reminders of it?
No, I haven't really had nightmares or unwanted memories of a specific event. But I have been feeling extremely on edge and easily startled by almost everything lately.
Around the time this began, was there a clear life stressor—like problems at work, school, relationships, finances, or a move—that seemed to bring this on?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about a specific stressor like that triggering all of this, it just feels like this overwhelming tension started out of nowhere.
Along with feeling on edge, have you been having physical symptoms like trouble sleeping, muscle tension, restlessness, or feeling easily fatigued?
No, I haven't really experienced those specific physical symptoms. I haven't noticed any muscle tension or trouble sleeping, and I wouldn't say I'm feeling easily fatigued.
How much is this affecting your daily life—like your work, school, relationships, or ability to manage everyday tasks?

It's having a huge impact on my daily life because my thinking feels so foggy that I can't even focus on simple conversations or reading. I also struggle with minor decisions like what to eat or wear, and I constantly forget where I put things because my concentration is so poor.
Before these past three weeks, have problems with attention, forgetfulness, or losing things been present since childhood, or are they completely new?
No, I never had any issues like this during childhood. This is completely new for me and only started about three weeks ago. Before this, my memory and focus were perfectly fine.

Just to clarify, in the past month have you been exposed to an actual or threatened death, serious injury, or sexual violence—either directly, by witnessing it, or learning it happened to a close loved one?
No, I'm not really sure, and I don't think I've been exposed to anything like that. I've just been feeling extremely overwhelmed and stressed lately without any specific event that I can point to.

Generalized Anxiety Disorder is less likely because the 6-month duration and associated physical symptoms were not met.
